name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: Love You to Death
original_name: คลับฟรายเดย์เดอะซีรีส์ คลับฟรายเดย์เดอะซีรีส์ Hot Love Issue เรื่องรัก เรื่องร้อน ตอน รักเธอจนตาย
overview: In recent new, incidents of self-harm in the name of love have been on the rise. One of the most excruciating experiences in one woman's life has been discovering her husband's infidelity after building a life together. Time passes, and the pain gradually begins to recede. However, one day, she stumbles upon an episode of Club Friday and hears a story that strikes a chord with her. The voice of the woman is strangely familiar, he narrative mirroring her own. It dawns on her that the caller is none other than her husband's mistress. She now finds herself listening to the unvarnished truth from a different perspective.
